title_sq: Tek Komuna E Parisit, Shitet Dyqan Ideal Per Investim!!
description_sq: Tek Komuna E Parisit, Shitet Dyqan Ideal Per Investim!! Dyqani ndodhet ne katin zero te nje pallati te mireadministruar me ashensor dhe siperfaqe totale 54.16 m2, nga te cilat siperfaqe brendshme 35.96 m2 dhe siperfaqe verande 18.20 m2. Dyqani ka fasade xhami duke e bere nje mundesi shume te mire reklamimi per biznesin qe deshironi te zhvilloni. Aktualisht dyqani eshte i dhene me qira 500 euro neto ne muaj. Prona disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
title_en: In the Municipality of Paris, an Ideal Store for Investment!!
description_en: In the Municipality of Paris, an Ideal Store for Investment!! The shop is located on the ground floor of a well-managed building with an elevator and a total area of ​​54.16 m2, of which 35.96 m2 of internal area and 18.20 m2 of veranda area. The store has a glass facade, making it a very good advertising opportunity for the business you want to develop. Currently, the store is rented for 500 euros net per month. The property has regular mortgage documentation.
